statement.zh: 将卡斯卡哈尔石碑简单定为「新大陆最早文字」且年代无争议，忽略其非原生层位语境——仍属假说。
statement.en: Calling the Cascajal Block simply the ‘oldest New World writing’ with unproblematic dating ignores its lack of primary stratigraphic context — remains a hypothesis.

disclaimer: Hypothesis / contested primacy claim — not established fact. Labelled kind=hypothesis.
